newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudis seen near barley deal, wide range of offers.
newsitem.headline: Saudis seen near barley deal, wide range of offers.

text.p: Saudi Arabia is in the last stages of negotiations to buy up to 1.2 million tonnes of barley at its tender but traders said on Wednesday deals had yet to be finalised.
Traders said shippers' offers appeared to be in a wide range of $151 to $165 per tonne, including cost and freight.
Exporters offered to supply the full tender quantity of 1.2 million tonnes, spread between February and March, they said.

But there was no firm word so far on the shape of the whole purchase. "There is no confirmation yet. We are waiting," said one trader. Tuesday's tender was for optional-origin barley, most of which is expected to come from the European Union.
European Commission sources hinted earlier on Wednesday they would consider bids for export refunds that valued European barley in the low $140s per tonne on a fob basis.
Traders put freight costs to Saudi Arabia at $19-20 per tonne.
